summary.text: Jheanelle Wilkins is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 20, where she has served since January 25, 2017, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Wilkins' 2025-2026 committee assignments, according to Ballotpedia, are the Rules & Executive Nominations Committee and the Ways & Means Committee, where she is vice chair.
